candidate_universe.role: Versioned census of completed MTBS mappings and reference-product availability; not independent ground truth.

incident_identity_and_maturity.revision_policy: Dynamic service; freeze exact schema, query, UTC retrieval time, dataLastEditDate, page bytes, and aggregate SHA-256 at intake.
incident_identity_and_maturity.role: Exact incident identifiers, wildfire type, state, final-report maturity, complex membership, and approved public incident perimeter.

ecology.role: Event-level ecological stratification only; not local ecological truth or a pixel label.

eligibility_semantics.universe_definition: Every MTBS version 12.0 row with Map_Prog exactly MTBS, ignition in 2021 or 2022, and a mapped centroid in ID, OR, or WA enters evaluation before any eligibility exclusion is applied.
eligibility_semantics.jurisdiction: WFIGS attr_POOState must exactly equal ID, OR, or WA and agree with the MTBS centroid state assignment. Conflict or missing evidence is unknown.
eligibility_semantics.incident_type: MTBS Incid_Type must equal WF and the exact WFIGS match attr_IncidentTypeCategory must equal WF.
eligibility_semantics.maturity: The exact WFIGS match must be public, approved, visible, not deleted, valid, not quarantined, and have non-null final-fire-report approval and fire-out timestamps. Candidate perimeter_status is final only when all conditions pass.
eligibility_semantics.area: Both MTBS BurnBndAc and WFIGS attr_FinalAcres must be at least 1,000 acres. There is no maximum-area exclusion. Missing or conflicting values are unknown.
eligibility_semantics.reference_availability: The retained row itself proves only that an MTBS mapping exists in version 12.0. It does not establish independent corroboration or ground truth.
eligibility_semantics.ecology: Intersect the MTBS boundary with EPA Level III polygons. At least 95 percent of boundary area must receive a valid Level III code. Dominant code is the largest intersection share, with lexicographic code only as an exact-area tie break.
eligibility_semantics.imagery_metadata: For both HLSL30 and HLSS30, anonymous CMR granule metadata must return at least one spatially intersecting record in each of two broad feasibility intervals: ignition minus 365 days through one second before ignition, and ignition through 730 days after ignition. No cloud, QA, scene-body, index, label, model, or metric filter is permitted in Milestone 1.
eligibility_semantics.prior_experiment_exclusion: Apply the exact 68-identity exclusion manifest first. Exact official-ID matches are excluded. A normalized name-year or geometry relationship that cannot be resolved exactly is unknown and therefore not eligible.
eligibility_semantics.unknown_policy: Any missing, contradictory, ambiguous, stale, structurally invalid, or unadmitted required value yields unknown or invalid, never eligible.

wfigs_denied_categories: usernames and creator or modifier fields
current suppression and behavior fields not required by eligibility

match_order: Exact non-null MTBS irwinID to WFIGS attr_IrwinID or poly_IRWINID
Exact non-null MTBS Event_ID to WFIGS attr_UniqueFireIdentifier
identity_and_duplicate_policy.date_agreement: MTBS and WFIGS ignition dates must differ by no more than one calendar day; otherwise unknown.
identity_and_duplicate_policy.probable_geometry_duplicate: Distinct candidates with intersection-over-union at least 0.50 and ignition dates within 30 days are marked probable_duplicate and are not eligible until an exact owner-approved resolution exists.
identity_and_duplicate_policy.complex_policy: Candidates sharing a non-null WFIGS complex ID remain separate eligible events but count as one selectable capacity slot, and at most one may enter the six-pilot plus 30-final cohort.

capacity_and_terminal_rules.shortfall_rule: If any state has fewer than 12 selectable slots, the total has fewer than 36, or the fixed ecology minima fail, stop Milestone 1 INCONCLUSIVE. Do not widen years, lower area, add states, reuse prior events, or substitute sources.

actions_released_only_if_owner_approves_: Freeze the 2026-002 eligibility profile without changing values.
Admit the five exact source entries for the specified roles and restrictions.
Perform controlled no-overwrite intake of the exact MTBS and EPA archives with checksum and format validation.
Capture one hash-bound WFIGS 2021-2022 snapshot using the exact field allowlist and fixed absolute query.
Query anonymous CMR metadata for the two exact HLS collections.
Enumerate and account for the complete metadata-defined universe, then run capacity and independent Milestone 1 validation.
still_not_authorized_after_approval: Open or download HLS imagery, MTBS rasters, severity classes, thresholds, labels, reference rasters, model artifacts, or predictions.
Authenticate to Earthdata or any external service.
Choose pilot or final events, draw AOIs, assign train, validation, or test roles, or alter the cohort design.
Use any denied source field, model output, spectral index, metric, label, error surface, or scene-body observation in eligibility.
Claim dataset readiness, independent ground truth, generalization, operational utility, or any scientific result.
